summary: Scenario PO03 started: Garbage truck round

scenario.name: Garbage truck round
scenario.description: The Twin starts a garbage-truck collection round (INCIDENTS trigger garbage_collection). On the mock, bin WGT-T003 also reaches 95 % and three more bins pass 80 %.
scenario.trigger: python scenarios/run.py PO03   (or the Run button on the control center; --server to play it on the running Brain, live or mock)

expected.twin: A truck drives its round of containers; bins fill.
expected.brain: Follows the truck round as a situation until the Twin closes it; sends a crew to every bin above 90 % (WGT empty); when 3 or more bins pass 75 %, orders its own truck round (INCIDENTS trigger garbage_collection).
